# Webhooks

Build a service that Monark notifies when something happens in your organization, such as a record created or a role assigned. An admin registers your URL and chooses the events in [Webhooks](/docs/administer/integrations/webhooks); these pages cover the receiving end.

- [Receive webhook deliveries](/docs/build/webhooks/receive-deliveries): accept deliveries, skip duplicates and test locally.
- [Verify webhook signatures](/docs/build/webhooks/verify-signatures): check each delivery came from Monark before acting on it.
